name: macd_trend_continuation_v71
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing multi-minute directional orders create persistent 3-8 minute micro-trends visible via EMA(60) slope. Within these micro-trends, 20-40 second pullbacks cause the 5s MACD to dip briefly negative. When the MACD histogram crosses back above its signal line while still negative, it marks the moment institutional buying has resumed before the full momentum re-accelerates — resting buy orders just absorbed the pullback supply, and the directional order flow is restarting. At 5-second resolution we enter this resumption point 10-20 seconds before it becomes visible on 1-minute bars, capturing the first 10-15 NIFTY spot points of continuation (5-7 option pts at delta ~0.5).

indicators.name: ema_fast
indicators.purpose: 12-bar (1-minute) fast EMA. Same 12/26/9 proportions as the original 15-min MACD — preserved because we want the same fast/slow ratio to detect the same momentum signal at compressed timescale. At 5s, 12 bars = 60s lookback, appropriate for a 30-120s hold.

indicators.name: ema_slow
indicators.purpose: 26-bar (2.2-minute) slow EMA. Preserves the 12/26 ratio from the original. At 5s bars this creates a MACD that turns negative after ~15-20 second pullbacks — exactly the pullback depth we want to detect before resumption.

indicators.name: macd_line
indicators.purpose: MACD line at 5s resolution. Goes negative during 20-40 second micro-pullbacks. The entry condition requires macd_line < 0 on long side (still in pullback), which filters out chasing moves that have already fully resumed.

indicators.name: macd_signal
indicators.purpose: 9-bar (45-second) signal line. Same proportion as original. The crossover of macd_hist (macd_line vs signal) detects the precise 5-second bar when pullback selling pressure exhausts and resumption begins.

indicators.name: ema_trend
indicators.purpose: 60-bar (5-minute) trend filter. Replaces original EMA(50) at 15-min (which was a 750-min / 12.5-hour filter). We compress to 5 minutes because we are trading a 30-120s move — the relevant trend context is 3-6 minutes, not hours. Ensures we only enter pullback resumptions when the broader 5-min micro-trend is intact.

conditions: CROSSOVER(macd_hist, 0) — histogram turns from negative to positive (pullback resuming up)
macd_line < 0 at crossover (still in pullback phase, not chasing a completed move)
buy_ce.confirmation: Histogram crossover from negative zone ensures we are catching the early resumption, not late entry after full acceleration

conditions: CROSSUNDER(macd_hist, 0) — histogram turns from positive to negative (bounce resuming down)
macd_line > 0 at crossover (still in bounce phase)
buy_pe.confirmation: Histogram crossunder from positive zone in a downtrend

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option pts = ~6 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. If NIFTY moves 6+ pts against us after a pullback resumption signal, the pullback is deepening (not resuming) and the 5-min trend is at risk of breaking — typical 5-min EMA support holds within 4-5 spot pts on NIFTY in normal conditions.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 NIFTY spot pts, which is a typical 30-90 second continuation leg after pullback exhaustion on NIFTY. Institutional TWAP flow resumes for 10-20 pts before the next micro-pause. Gives 1:1.67 R:R at stop=3.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX not used; pullback/resumption pattern works across vol regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST; skip first 10 minutes (pre-open noise) and last 10 minutes
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY volume is continuous; index volume unreliable at 5s
filters.trend_filter: EMA(60) directional filter — only trade in trend direction
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — MACD patterns are widely traded; edge relies on 5s resolution advantage over 1-min traders

adaptation_notes: Original used EMA(50) as trend filter on 15-min bars (= 750-min context) — compressed to EMA(60) at 5s (= 5-min context) because our 30-120s hold requires a proportionally shorter trend window. Original's MACD 12/26/9 proportions PRESERVED because the fast/slow ratio determines what counts as a 'pullback' vs 'trend', and we want the same relative structure at 5s scale. The critical insight: original's entry condition `macd_line < 0` on longs is retained — this is the key differentiator that catches pullback resumption rather than late-entry chasing. Hold time compressed from 5-15 bars × 15min (75-225 min) to 6-24 bars × 5s (30-120s).
weaknesses: MACD at 5s is very noisy — many false crossovers in choppy NIFTY conditions
EMA(60) trend filter can be stale during intraday trend reversals
At 5s bars, MACD crossovers happen every few minutes — max_trades_per_day cap is critical
The macd_line < 0 filter may over-restrict entries when NIFTY is in a strong sustained trend
